# World Panel Nodes

The characters, items, places and location the World State panel shows: read them, and add a person, object or place named in a message.

| Node | Registry path |

## Add Snapshot Entity

`agents/world_state/AddSnapshotEntity`

Add a person, object or place named in a message to the world snapshot
and keep it tracked, as selecting text in a message and choosing Add to
world state does. One analysis request; the model may find no distinct
entity in the text, and then nothing is added. Like the UI add, it
cancels a running snapshot refresh; run from a listener of the
snapshot's own events, it adds without cancelling it.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state (passthrough) |
| `message` | `message_object` | (optional) the message the text comes from (or give message_id) |
| `message_id` | `int` | (optional) the message id (or give message) |
| `text` | `str` | the text that names the entity |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state |
| `resolved` | `bool` | True when an entity was added |
| `name` | `str` | the entity name |
| `kind` | `str` | character, item or place |
| `in_moment` | `bool` | True when the message is in the snapshot's current moment |
| `mentions` | `list` | phrases of the message marked as the entity |
| `waiting_for_regeneration` | `bool` | True when nothing ran because the snapshot is being regenerated |

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message_id` | `int` | `0` | message_id |

## Get Snapshot

`agents/world_state/GetSnapshot`

The current world snapshot, as the World State panel shows it. Reads the
stored snapshot; it does not refresh it.

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `characters` | `dict` | name to state (snapshot, emotion, mentions) for each character |
| `items` | `dict` | name to state (snapshot, mentions) for each item |
| `places` | `dict` | name to state (snapshot, mentions) for each place |
| `location` | `str` | the location description, or None |
